text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s a-n-d l-e-f-t f-a-l-s-e p-e-r-m-i-t c-o-p-i-e-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the o-f-f-i-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
2) they f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-i-e-s a-n-d l-e-f-t a f-a-k-e b-l-o-o-d-l-i-n-e a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-a-l-l.
3) the a-c-t-o-r p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s m-a-r-k-e-d a-s c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-d a-n-d l-e-f-t m-i-s-l-e-a-d-i-n-g m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-a-m-p-l-i-n-g a-u-d-i-t.
4) they a-d-d-e-d b-l-u-r-r-y p-h-o-t-o s-h-a-d-o-w-s t-o l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s a-n-d l-e-f-t i-n-c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e g-e-n-e-a-l-o-g-y p-r-o-o-f w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-h-e-c-k-s-u-m.
5) the a-c-t-o-r c-l-e-a-r-e-d c-h-a-t l-o-g-s a-f-t-e-r s-a-l-e-s a-n-d l-e-f-t t-r-a-c-e-s i-n s-h-i-p-p-i-n-g m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the h-a-s-h v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
